gatO । (BvAdiM-ilapakze adAM-paraM-sakaM-aniw .) ayati । la eti । pfTakpAWasAmarTyAt pUrvvo na lit । Sezastu ina gatAviti prasidDaH । yino'cyaRAvityAdizu grahaRamasyEva । iti durgAdAsaH ॥ (ut .) udaye । samunnatO । yaTA, -- “udayati yadi BAnuH paScime digviBAge” iti । (aBi + ut .) aByudaye । samunnatO । sarvveH gatyarTA jYAnArTAH prAptyarTASca ityanena prAptyarTe'pyasya bahulaH prayogaH । yaTA, -- manuH । “brAhmaRaH SrezWatAmeti pratyavAyena SUdratAm” । “ayameti mandaM mandaM kAverIvAripAvanaH pavanaH” । iti sAhityadarpaRam । (ati) atikrame । parABave । yaTA, hitopadeSe । 1 । “atItya hi guRAn sarvvAn svaBAvo mUrdDi varttate” । “tataH paraM janasTAnaM kroSatrayamatItya vE” । iti rAmAyaRe । (anu) anukaraRam । “DAnurAdeSamanveti tadyaTA hi tadarpaRaH । nAtmADIno manuzyo'yaM kAlaM Bajati kaYcana” ॥ iti mahABArate । (apa) apagamane । palAyane । “pratyAdeSavyalIkamapEtu te” । iti SAkuntale । (sam + A) sammilane । “devAScEtAn saBatyocUrnyAyyaM vaH SiSuruktavAn” । iti manuH । 2 । 152 । ityAdayo jYeyAH .)

la, smftyAM । (adAM-paraM-sakaM-aniw .) aDipUrvvo'yaM । aDigrahaRaM anyapUrvvasya । kevalasya ca prayoganirAsArTaM । evaM sarvvatra । la aDyeti tava lakzmaRaH । ika smaraRe iti prasidDo'yaM । invadika ityatrAsyEva grahaRam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

Na la aDyayane । (adA॰-A॰ -saka॰ -aniw .) aDipUrvvo'yaM । aDyayanamarTataH SabdataSca guruto grahaRaM । Na la vedamaDIte vipraH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥ (“yaH svADyAyamaDIte'bdaM viDinA niyataH SuciH” iti manuH । 2 । 137 .)

“iHsU kzmA SAlmalI vidyA candraH pUzA suguhyakaH । sumitraH sundaroDIraH kowarI kowaraHpayaH । BrumaDyomADavastuzwirdakzanetraYca nAsikA । SAntaH kAntiH kAminI ca kAmoviGnavinAyakaH । nepAlo BaraRIrudronityaklinnA ca povakaH” ।

“ikAraM paramAnandaM suganDakusumacCavim । haribrahmamayaM varRaM sadArudrayutaM priye ॥ sadA SaktimayaM devi! gurubrahma mayaM taTA । sadASivamayaM varRaM paraM brahmasamanvitam । haribrahmAtmakaM varRaM guRatrayasamanvitam । ikAraM parameSAni! svayaM kuRqalImUrttikam” ।
m: 1. इ the third vowel of the alphabet, corresponding to i short, and pronounced as that letter in kill &c.
2. इ ind. an interjection of anger, calling, sorrow, distress, compassion, &c., (g. चादि, Pāṇ. i, 4, 57, &c.)
3. इ base of Nom. and Acc. sg. du. and pl. of the demonstrative pronoun इदम्, ‘this’ or ‘that’
इ [cf. इतर, इतस्, इति, इद्, इदा, इयत्, इव, इह: cf. also Lat. id; Goth. ita; Eng. it; Old Germ. iz; Mod. Germ. es.]
4. इ m. N. of Kāmadeva, L.

5. इ cl. 2. P. एति (Impv. 2. sg. इहि) and 1. P. Ā. अयति, अयते [cf. √ अय्], (pf. इयाय [2. sg. इयथ, AV. viii, 1, 10, and इयेथ, RV.] fut. एष्यति; aor. ऐषीत्; inf. एतुम्, एतवे, RV. & AV., एतवै, RV. एतोस्, RV. इत्यै, RV. i, 113, 6; 124, 1) to go, walk; to flow; to blow; to advance, spread, get about; to go to or towards (with acc.), come, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh.; R.; Hit.; Ragh. &c.; to go away, escape, pass, retire, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; R.; to arise from, come from, RV.; ChUp.; to return (in this sense only fut.), MBh.; R.; (with पुनर्) to come back again, return, MBh.; R.; Pañcat. &c.; to succeed, Mn. iii, 127; to arrive at, reach, obtain, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; Śak.; Hit. &c.; to fall into, come to; to approach with prayers, gain by asking (cf. इत); to undertake anything (with acc.); to be employed in, go on with, continue in any condition or relation (with a part. or instr., e.g. असुर-रक्षसानि मृद्यमानानि यन्ति, ‘the Asuras and Rakshases are being continually crushed’, ŚBr. i, 1, 4, 14; गवामयनेनेयुः, ‘they, were engaged in the [festival called] Gavāmayana’, KātyŚr. xxv, 5, 2); to appear, be, KaṭhUp. : Intens. Ā. ईयते (RV. i, 30, 18; p. इयान, RV.; inf. इयध्यै, RV. vi, 20, 8) to go quickly or repeatedly; to come, wander, run, spread, get about, RV.; AV.; VS.; to appear, make one's appearance, RV.; AV.; BṛĀrUp.; to approach any one with requests (with two acc.), ask, request, RV.; AV.: Pass. ईयते, to be asked or requested, RV.: Caus. आययति, to cause to go or escape, Vop.;
इ [cf. Gk. εἶ-μι, ἴ-μεν; Lat. e-o, ī-mus, i-ter, &c.; Lith. ei-mì, ‘I go’; Slav. i-dû, ‘I go’, i-ti, ‘to go’; Goth. i-ddja, ‘I went’.]
a: इ — The third letter of the Devanāgarī alphabet.
इः — [अ-इञ्] N. of Kāmadeva. --ind. An interjection of (1) anger; (2) calling; (3) compassion; (4) reproach; (5) wonder; (6) sorrow; (7) distress.

इ — {vI.v} {c2c} P. (In Dhātup. written as इण्) (एति, इयाय, अगात्, एतुं, इत) 1 To go, go to or towards, come to or near; शशिनं पुनरेति शर्वरी R. 8. 56; ईयुर्भरद्वाजमुनेर्निकेतं Bk. 3. 40. --2 To arrive at, reach, obtain, attain to, go to or be reduced to a particular state, fall into; निर्बुद्धिः क्षयमेति Mk. 1. 14 goes to ruin, is ruined; so वशं, शत्रुत्वं, शूद्रतां &c. --3 To return. --4 To go away, retire; elapse, pass. --5 To spring from, come or arise from. --6 To undertake anything (with acc.); सत्रमायन् Vāj. --7 To ask, beg. --8 To be; to appear. --9 To be employed in, go on with, be in a particular condition or relation, with a part. or instr.; कृषंतो ह स्म वैवपंतो यंति Śat. Br.; गवामयनेनेयुः Kāty. --10 To thrive, prosper. {vII.v} {c1c} U. = अय् q. v. {vIII.v} {c4c} A. 1 To come, appear. --2 To run, wander. --3 To go quickly or repeatedly. --4 To ask, request. --Caus. To cause to go or come. [cf. L. eo; Gr. eimi with एमि].
